paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.03% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+1.49%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.96%). Brent crude changed +3.16% to 109.03. Gold changed -0.94% to 4,138.0. Bitcoin changed +0.72% to 82,729.1328. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.132%, a relative move of -1.63%. Among the firms tracked, BlackRock (+6.29%) and Bank of America (-5.72%) moved the most.
